report.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 2400ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is most likely associated with the active failure domain, specifically: Client-side p99 latency: 2400ms vs server-side Cosmos latency: 12ms — 2388ms gap indicates client/SDK or host overhead; Host CPU: 85% — CPU burn path active (fibonacci loop on request path); Azure Cosmos DB server-side latency: 12ms — within normal range, indicating service is healthy. Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained nominal (server-side latency: 12ms). Azure SQL Database remained healthy. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
report.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 2400ms with 0 Cosmos 429 events, 75 RU/min consumption, host CPU 85%, and SQL latency 65ms. The active toggles (highCpu) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 2388ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
